notes: Launcher: choosing to play without a confirmed identity no longer switches the device into Offline Mode. That switch is what the updater treats as its one authoritative gate, so the only enabled control at the launcher was silently disabling update checks for good. The control is now labelled CONTINUE unless Offline Mode was actually chosen, and the update panel says OFFLINE MODE IS ON with a GO ONLINE action instead of a RETRY that could not succeed. Anyone already stuck can tap GO ONLINE, or reopen the version panel from the game.
